rules: Host and symbiont retain traceable pre-joining identity/history.
Joined lived identity is a persistent synthesis state, not the simple return of a previous host.
Previous-host memories and skills are available only when Core has made specific content accessible.
Joining does not grant omniscient access to all prior experience.
Previous relationships may affect the current joined character but do not automatically recreate identical relationship state.
Medical compatibility and joining state are private unless valid knowledge exists.
Joining/separation is an authoritative lifecycle/medical event and cannot be created by AI dialogue.
Save/load and LOD preserve host, symbiont and joining history.
